# Vendored front-end libraries

Copied from cdnjs so the app works without internet (hackathon demos). Verified against cdnjs's published SRI hashes (sha512).

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/ | BSD-2-Clause |
| Chart.js | 4.4.1 | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/4.4.1/ | MIT |
